metadata.case_name: LIMBU DHARAMARAJ v. ISS ADAMS SECUFORCE LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: not working at the time of the trial

source: The Plaintiff therefore sustained injuries to his right ankle, right shoulder and right side of his back.

Spine: They did not find any neurological deficit and no lumbosacral nerve root impingement in the MRI scan．The back pain should be of a minor degree. They found exaggeration or functional overlay on the part of the Plaintiff in his complaint.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: shoulder sprain with soft tissue injury
source: The Plaintiff therefore sustained injuries to his right ankle, right shoulder and right side of his back.
Right shoulder: the injury in 2008 should be a shoulder sprain with soft tissue injury and had recovered well (page 218).
No permanent disability caused by the right shoulder sprain;
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of shoulder joint

injuries.description: right ankle injury / soft tissue injury
source: The Plaintiff therefore sustained injuries to his right ankle, right shoulder and right side of his back.

Right ankle: no external deformity or swelling was found on the right ankle; there was no detectable collateral laxity and the ankle movement was satisfactory; no significant structural damage was found.

manifestations.description: The Plaintiff hief complaint was right shoulder pain.
He also complained of low back pain and right ankle pain.
walking in a limping gait and still complained of persistent low back pain and right thigh pain
there was tenderness in his right ankle
He could not walk without a stick for over 15 minutes.
He found it difficult to walk on stairs.
Due to his back pain, he had to wear a broad belt to help him.

treatments_received.treatment: Emergency treatment at Tuen Mun Hospital AED with oral analgesic and painkiller injection
source: According to Dr Chan of Tuen Mun Hospital, he saw the Plaintiff on 26 November 2008 in the AED. The Plaintiff hief complaint was right shoulder pain. He was treated and given some oral analgesic and a painkiller injection. He was discharged with 5 days sick leave.

treatments_received.treatment: Follow-up treatments and physiotherapy at Tuen Mun Hospital and later clinics
source: Follow-up treatments and physiotherapy treatments were carried out in Tuen Mun Hospital. His follow-up treatments were later taken up by clinics. An MRI scan was carried out on 8 April 2009.
An MRI scan was carried out on 8 April 2009.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He could no longer play volley ball or to enjoy other sports (as claimed in his Revised Statement of Damages).

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy quiet or solitude
losses.description: He was unable to sleep well due to persistent pain over his right ankle and lower back (as stated in his Revised Statement of Damages).
